newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Comafi reinitiates Frances as hold.
newsitem.headline: Comafi reinitiates Frances as hold.

text.p: Argentina's Banco Comafi said Tuesday it reinitiated coverage of Banco Frances, controlled by Spain's Banco de Bilbao Vizcaya, with a "hold" recommendation.

"Frances has historically traded at a premium to the other Argentine banks due to its excellent management, high capitalization, liquidity and solvency," analysts Esteban Marx and Eduardo Cogorno wrote in a report dated July 11.
"This also adds to the positive effect of Frances's recent acquisition of Banco Credito Argentino, as it will allow it to enhance and strenghthen its regional presence and penetration."
But in the short term the merger will generate the negative features implied in every acquisition process which, together with Frances's high book value, lead to a "hold" recommendation, they said.
Comafi's ratings are buy, attractive, hold, non-attractive and sell.
